notes: A wizard releasing a spell, as a Roman candle fires (the owner, 2026-11-18): a deep, hollow thoomp out of a tube. Its body is the tube's own ring (noise through narrow bands falling from 340 and 640 Hz, a soft 12 ms attack), over a sine dropping from 170 to 60 Hz and a dull puff of the charge, with a breath of the shot leaving after it. Nothing above 3 kHz, so four players casting fast are a low patter under the fight, never a hiss over it; 3 dB under the family's level (gain -3), as the sound heard most, which also keeps the ring's noise under the peak. Longer, hollower and falling, where a hit is a short dry knock.
